purpose: We are building a wearable patch that detects irregular heart rhythm and need to know how many people in Austria live with atrial fibrillation to design our validation study with cardiologists.
question: How many patients have atrial fibrillation in each region?
definitions: Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Report per region: patients with atrial fibrillation.
